description: Route funds from the client-owned main EOA to a currently certified venue. Prediction-market and crypto funding are available; Derive/options funding is under release hold and must not be started. Native Polygon USDC is converted to USDC.e only as needed, with hashes disclosed. The owner key signs locally and never reaches Felix.

account_id.description: Target a specific child account (UUID) instead of the launcher's default account. The child owner key is derived locally; it never reaches Felix.

auto_swap_native_usdc.description: Automatically convert only the native Polygon USDC needed for this funding operation. Defaults to true; set false to require a separate explicit swap.

idempotency_key.description: Required workflow replay key. Reuse it after any timeout or restart.

minimum_receive_usd.description: Optional minimum final venue credit. The route fails closed before submission when its bounded quote cannot satisfy this floor.

resume_reconciliation.description: Set true only after inspecting the original workflow and its submitted hashes. Reuses saved checkpoints and the original idempotency_key; never starts a second fee payment or venue transfer.

name: fund_market
